DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝の体操に、ご参加をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you thinking of joining the morning exercises?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は見てみたいだけです。前へ立つと参加者に見えるので、後ろから見学してもよい場所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 体操は参加でなく見学のみと説明し場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only want to watch today. Standing at the front would make me look like a participant, so I would like to know where I can watch from behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you only want to observe the exercises rather than participate, and ask where to watch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、横のベンチからご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can watch from the bench at the side, keeping the walkway clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベンチへ座ります。参加者の列の後ろへ入らず、動きを見て、次回参加するか考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列に入らずベンチから観察して次回を考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will sit on the bench. Rather than joining the back of the participants' line, I want to watch the movements and consider joining next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will watch from the bench without joining the line and consider participating next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見学中も、周りの方が通れるようにしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: While watching, please also leave room for people around you to pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かばんは膝へ載せます。隣の席に置いて、見学用に二席取らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物は膝に載せ二席占有しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put my bag on my lap. I will not put it on the next seat and take up two seats just to watch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep your bag on your lap and not occupy two seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご質問があれば、終わった後に担当へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you have questions, please speak to the organizer after the session ends.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 参加する時の持ち物を聞きたいです。今は体操を止めず、終わってから担当の方へ尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持物質問は会を中断せず終了後担当へ尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to ask what to bring when participating. I will not interrupt the exercises now; I will ask the organizer after they finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will ask the organizer about what to bring after the session, without interrupting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は何時までご覧になる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until what time do you plan to watch today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この回が終わるまで見学します。終わったら、次回の日と持ち物を担当の方へ聞いてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一回の見学後に次回の日と持ち物を尋ねて帰る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will watch until this session ends. Afterward I will ask the organizer the date of the next session and what to bring before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will observe one session, then ask about the next date and what to bring before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ベンチからごゆっくりご覧ください。よい朝をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time watching from the bench. Have a pleasant morning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行き先の切符をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a ticket to your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は列車に乗りません。友人を見送って、荷物をホームまで手伝いたいです。私も乗車券を買う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分は旅行せず友人荷物の見送りでホーム入場方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will not be taking the train. I want to see my friend off and help carry their luggage to the platform. Do I need to buy a travel ticket too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are not traveling and ask how to enter the platform to help with your friend's luggage and see them off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗らずにホームへ入る場合は、こちらの入場の手続きをご案内できます。見送りの後は、同じ駅から出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you enter the platform without riding, I can explain the admission procedure here. Will you leave from this same station after seeing your friend off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。友人だけが旅行します。私は荷物を渡したら、この駅の改札から外へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は同駅から外へ戻り友人だけが旅行すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Only my friend is traveling. After handing over the luggage, I will go back outside through this station's ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will go back outside from the same station and only your friend is traveling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この入場券は百五十円です。列車に乗るための券ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This platform ticket costs one hundred fifty yen. It is not a ticket for riding a train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、一枚お願いします。百五十円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 百五十円の入場券一枚を購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then one, please. That is one hundred fifty yen, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Buy one platform ticket for one hundred fifty yen in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが入場券です。出る時にも必要なので、お持ちください。友人の発車時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is your platform ticket. Keep it with you, as you need it when leaving too. Do you know your friend's departure time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十一時です。荷物をホームで渡して、発車前に扉から離れて見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十一時の列車をホームから見送り荷物を渡す予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Eleven o'clock. I will hand over the luggage on the platform and move away from the doors before departure to see my friend off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will hand over the luggage and see your friend off from the platform for the eleven o'clock train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ホームでは通行の妨げにならないようお願いします。お帰りは出口の改札へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not obstruct passage on the platform. When you return, use the exit ticket gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。この入場券をしまって、友人と荷物を持ちます。見送りが終わったら、券を使って改札から出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券をしまい見送り後出口改札で出ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will put this platform ticket away and carry the luggage with my friend. When I have finished seeing them off, I will use the ticket to leave through the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put the ticket away and leave through the exit gate after seeing your friend off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご友人とお気をつけてホームへどうぞ。お見送りの後もお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care as you and your friend go to the platform. Have a safe journey home after seeing them off too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 保育の申込みについて、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the childcare application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 必要な物に就労証明書とあります。私は会社で働いていますが、この窓口で証明書を出してもらうのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 就労証明書を市役所が発行するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The required items include an employment certificate. I work for a company. Is this counter where I have the certificate issued?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether city hall issues the employment certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書式は、勤務先に就労状況を記入してもらう物です。こちらで働き方を証明して発行する物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The form is for your employer to enter your employment details. We do not certify your working arrangements and issue it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社にお願いするのですね。会社は日本語の用紙があれば書けると言っています。空の用紙を一枚いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先記入と理解し空の日本語用紙を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I ask my company. They say they can fill it out if there is a form in Japanese. Could I have one blank form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese that you understand the employer fills it out, and request a blank Japanese form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの用紙です。勤務日数や時間などの欄があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the form. It has fields for the number of working days and working hours, among other things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勤務日数と時間の欄もありますね。勤務先の事務担当に、この用紙を渡してお願いしてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務日数と時間の欄を確認し会社の事務担当へ作成を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are fields for working days and hours too. I will give this form to the administrative staff at my workplace and ask them to prepare it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the working-day and hour fields and say in Japanese that you will ask your company's administrative staff to prepare it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申込書は、別に保護者の方が記入してください。会社が書く用紙と分けてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The parent or guardian should fill out the application separately. It is separate from the form the company completes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの用紙を分けます。会社へ就労証明書だけ渡し、申込書は自分で書いて持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社用就労証明と自分用申込書を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the two forms separate. I will give only the employment certificate to my company and fill out the application myself to bring back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the employment certificate for the company from the application you fill out yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そろいましたら、申込期限までにお出しください。期限は案内の金曜です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once everything is ready, submit it before the application deadline. The deadline is the Friday in the guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金曜までですね。会社にその日を伝えて作成をお願いし、間に合わない場合は、期限前にこの窓口へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金曜期限を会社へ伝え間に合わなければ期限前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: By Friday, right? I will tell my company that date and ask them to prepare it. If it will not be ready in time, I will consult this counter before the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will tell your company the Friday deadline and consult the counter before the deadline if it will not be ready in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な用紙と案内をお持ちください。それでは、お手続きのご準備をお願いします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the necessary forms and guide. Please prepare for the application procedure. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご受診ですね。こちらの問診票をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit, correct? Please fill out this medical questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右手を固定していて、字を書けません。左手では読める字にならないので、口で答えて記入を手伝ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右手固定で記入できず本人の口頭回答の代筆を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right hand is immobilized and I cannot write. My writing with my left hand would not be legible, so could you help fill it out while I answer aloud?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your right hand is immobilized and ask someone to write your own spoken answers for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人が答えた内容を、こちらで記入します。お名前から伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will enter the answers you give yourself. May I start by asking your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエン・アンです。名字と名前の順は、この本人確認の資料で見てください。口で言うだけでは取り違えるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名を資料と照らして記入してほしいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is Nguyen An. Please check the order of my family and given names in this identification document. Just saying them aloud could lead to a mix-up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want your name entered by checking it against the document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料と照らします。受診したいことも、お話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the document. Please also tell me what you want to be seen for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右手のけがを診てもらいたいです。昨日、別の所で固定してもらいました。その時の書類も持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右手けがと昨日の固定処置の書類持参を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want my right-hand injury examined. I had it immobilized somewhere else yesterday. I have the paperwork from that visit too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese about the right-hand injury and that you brought documents from yesterday's immobilization treatment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その書類は医療担当へお渡しください。記入した内容は、最後にご本人にも確認していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please give those papers to the medical staff. At the end, you will also check what I have entered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の説明を確かめたいので、書いていただいた内容を最後に読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 代筆した内容を本人が確認するため読み上げを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to check that my explanation is correct, so could you read out what you have written at the end?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the written answers to be read aloud so you can check them yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ここまで記入した名前と、昨日固定を受けたことを読み上げます。違う所があればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will read the name entered so far and the fact that you had the hand immobilized yesterday. Please tell me if anything is wrong.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: どちらも合っています。記入を手伝ってくださってありがとうございます。この書類は診察で自分から見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読み上げた記入を確認し診察書類を自分で示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both are correct. Thank you for helping me fill it out. I will show these treatment papers myself during the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the entries read aloud and say you will personally show the treatment documents during the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、問診票をお預かりします。診察のご案内まで、こちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take the medical questionnaire now. Please wait here until we call you for the examination. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 知らない相手からの連絡について、ご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to consult us about contact from someone you do not know, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 警察だと名乗る人から画像が来ました。制服のような服を着ていますが、ビデオ通話で身分証を見せるよう言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 制服画像の送信者からビデオ通話で身分証提示を求められたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone claiming to be a police officer sent me an image. They are wearing something like a uniform, but they are asking me to show identification on a video call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the sender of a uniformed image asked you to show identification over a video call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その要求に応じましたか。身分証の画像を送ったかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you complied with that request? Please also tell me whether you have sent an image of your identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもまだです。制服なら本物だと思いかけましたが、顔や名前を見せる前に相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通話も送信も未実施で事前相談したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have done neither yet. I almost thought a uniform meant they were genuine, but I came to consult you before showing my face or name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you have neither called nor sent anything and came to consult in advance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届いた連絡を、消さずに確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you show us the messages you received without deleting them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この画面です。連絡は今日の十一時からで、同じ相手が何度も急ぐよう書いています。今は返信していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十一時以降の要求画面と未返信を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the screen. The messages started at eleven today, and the same person has repeatedly written that I must hurry. I am not replying now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese the requests received since eleven and say that you are not replying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手の表示名や、連絡の届いた方法も確認します。通話はつながったことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check the sender's display name and how the contact arrived. Have you ever connected a call with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通話したことはありません。このアプリのメッセージだけです。画像だけで、どこの警察かも確かめられていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: アプリ内連絡のみで所属を確認できていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have never spoken with them on a call. It is only messages in this app. I only have the image and have not been able to confirm which police department they belong to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that contact is only within the app and you have not verified their affiliation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。そのまま保存し、要求された内容を順に伺います。新たに来た要求も、応じずお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I understand. Keep it saved as it is, and I will ask about the requests in order. If new requests arrive, do not comply; let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 画像と連絡を残します。身分証を見せる要求と、急がせる文をお伝えし、ここで相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画像を保存し提示要求と急がせる内容を窓口へ引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the image and messages. I will explain the demand to show identification and the messages pressuring me to hurry, and continue consulting here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will save the image and relay the identification demand and pressure to hurry to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼んで、こちらで詳しくお話を伺います。画面を保存したまま、少しお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will call the person in charge to hear the details here. Please wait a moment, keeping the screen saved. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加のお手紙をお送りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending an additional letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、契約の書類を送りましたが、一枚だけ机に残っていました。この一枚を追加で送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の契約書類の一枚不足を今日別便で送りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I sent contract documents yesterday, but one sheet was left on my desk. I want to send that one sheet as an addition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that one sheet was missing from yesterday's contract documents and you want to send it separately today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日の郵便物へここで同封はできません。別の便で届くことについて、提出先にはお伝えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot add it to yesterday's mail here. Have you told the recipient that it will arrive separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝電話しました。一枚不足と伝え、追加で送ってよいと言われました。最初の書類を全部送り直すようには言われていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先が不足一枚別送を認め全書類再送指示なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I called this morning. I said one sheet was missing and was told I could send it additionally. They did not tell me to resend all the original documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the recipient agreed to the separate missing sheet and did not instruct you to resend all documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、追加の一枚をお送りですね。新しい封筒はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you are sending the one additional sheet. Do you have a new envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒です。不足していた一枚と、昨日の書類の追加分だと分かる短い手紙を入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足紙と前便追加と説明する手紙を新封筒へ入れたと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the envelope. I put in the missing sheet and a short letter explaining that it is an addition to yesterday's documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese that you put the missing sheet and a letter identifying it as an addition to the previous mailing in a new envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回の宛先と差出人も、新しい封筒にお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write this mailing's recipient and sender on the new envelope too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書きました。宛先は昨日と同じ提出先です。手紙にも私の名前と、最初に送った日を書いたので、別の人の書類と取り違えられないようにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新宛先差出人と自己名最初発送日で前便を識別すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have written them. The recipient is the same office as yesterday. I also wrote my name and the original mailing date in the letter so it will not be confused with someone else's documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the new envelope has the recipient and sender, and your name and first mailing date identify the previous mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、この封筒の重さと送り方を確認します。昨日の便と、今回の便は別にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check this envelope's weight and mailing method. I will explain yesterday's mailing and this mailing separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この封筒の送り方をお願いします。今日の発送が済んだら、追加分を出したと提出先へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加分の送り方を依頼し実際の発送後に提出先へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please advise me on the mailing method for this envelope. After it has actually been sent today, I will tell the recipient that I sent the addition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about sending the additional documents and say you will contact the recipient after actually mailing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、発送の担当が重さと料金をご案内します。封筒はこちらへどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The mailing clerk will explain the weight and postage. Please pass the envelope here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みをご希望ですね。ご依頼はご本人のお口座からでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to make a transfer, correct? Is it from your own account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私個人の口座ではなく、勤務先の会社の振込です。上司から用紙を持って来るよう頼まれましたが、私がどこまでできるか先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自己口座ではない会社振込の依頼用紙持参と権限確認を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a transfer for my employer's company, rather than my personal account. My supervisor asked me to bring the form, but I first want to check how much I am authorized to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you brought a request form for a company transfer, not your own account, and want to check your authority.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社のお手続きとして、担当が権限と必要な書類を確認します。今お持ちなのは、どの資料ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: As a company procedure, the specialist will check your authority and the required documents. What materials do you have with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この依頼用紙と会社の担当者の連絡先です。上司からは、用紙を窓口に渡すよう言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参した会社用紙と連絡先、上司からの依頼範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This request form and the company contact person's details. My supervisor told me to hand the form to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the company form and contact details you brought and the scope of your supervisor's request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認が必要な書類について担当からご説明します。会社の担当者に、今ご連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The specialist will explain the documents that need checking. Can you contact the company representative now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、電話できます。追加で必要な物があれば、その担当者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社担当者へ電話できると伝え不足書類を取り次ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I can call. If anything else is required, I will pass that information to the representative.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can call the company representative and relay information about missing documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も担当へ引き継ぎます。振込の相手と金額が書かれた用紙はこちらですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that along to the specialist too. Is this the form showing the transfer recipient and amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。送金先と金額は会社が書いたものです。記入した担当者の名前も、この下にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送金先と金額の記入者を示して会社用紙を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The company entered the recipient and amount. The name of the staff member who completed it is also here at the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the company form and indicate who entered the recipient and amount in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、会社取引の担当が伺います。確認後、可能な手続きと不足している物をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person handling corporate transactions will assist you. After checking, we will explain what procedures are possible and what is missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。銀行で確認した結果と、会社で用意する物があれば、それも上司へ報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認結果と必要な追加資料を会社へ報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will report the bank's findings to my supervisor, along with anything the company needs to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report the verification results and any additional required documents to your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちください。それでは、担当へ引き継ぎます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here. I will hand this over to the specialist. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申し訳ありません。今はカード端末を使えず、現金でのお会計をご案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I am sorry. Our card terminal is unavailable now, so we are asking customers to pay cash.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カードで払うつもりでした。現金は五百円だけなので、買う物を減らしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現金五百円しかないため購入品を減らせるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intended to pay by card. I only have five hundred yen in cash. May I reduce the items I buy?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can buy fewer items because you have only five hundred yen in cash.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かごの中は、パン三百円と、洗剤四百円です。合計は七百円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your basket contains bread for three hundred yen and detergent for four hundred yen. The total is seven hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンは今日食べる物なので買います。洗剤は家に少し残っているので、今回は見送ります。パンだけにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: パン三百を優先し家に残る洗剤四百は見送ると選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will buy the bread because it is for eating today. There is a little detergent left at home, so I will pass on that this time. Can I buy just the bread?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese to prioritize the three-hundred-yen bread and leave the four-hundred-yen detergent because some remains at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 洗剤はこちらでお預かりします。パンだけでしたら三百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will take the detergent back here. Just the bread costs three hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パンだけでお願いします。こちらの五百円で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パン三百円だけを選び五百円で支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just the bread, please. I will pay with this five-hundred-yen coin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose only the three-hundred-yen bread and pay with five hundred yen in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 五百円をお預かりします。パン三百円のお会計です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have received five hundred yen. The bill is three hundred yen for the bread.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 釣銭は二百円ですね。パンだけのレシートもいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二百円の釣銭とパンだけのレシートを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The change is two hundred yen, right? Could I also have a receipt showing only the bread?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the two hundred yen change and a receipt for only the bread in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二百円と、パンだけのレシートをどうぞ。袋は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are two hundred yen and the receipt for just the bread. Do you need a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の袋があります。パン一つ、釣銭二百円、レシートを受け取りました。洗剤は次の買物で考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己袋とパン釣銭控え受領を確認し洗剤は次回と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my own bag. I have received one loaf of bread, two hundred yen change, and the receipt. I will consider detergent on my next shopping trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you have your own bag and received the bread, change, and receipt, and will consider detergent next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご対応ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Have a safe journey home. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落葉の清掃中ですので、こちらの道は少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are clearing fallen leaves, so please wait a little before using this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩の途中ですが、少し時間があります。何かお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩途中の短時間で手伝える作業があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am out for a walk, but I have a little time. Is there anything I can help with?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether there is a task you can help with briefly during your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらでは職員がほうきを使います。お手伝いなら、袋の口を持っていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. The staff will use the brooms here. If you want to help, you can hold the mouth of a bag open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋の口を持てばよいのですね。どこに立ちましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋口保持の作業と立つ場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should hold the bag open. Where should I stand?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the task of holding the bag open and where to stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この広い所でお願いします。枝などを見つけても、ご自身で拾い集めずこちらへ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please stand in this wide area. If you find branches or similar things, do not collect them yourself; let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手袋は持っていないので、袋の口を持つだけならできます。枝を見つけたら声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手袋なしで袋内や枝に触れず広い位置で保持すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not have gloves, so I can help if it is only holding the bag open. If I find a branch, I will call you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that without gloves you will only hold the bag in the wide area, without touching its contents or branches.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋へ入れ終わったら、職員が口を閉じます。お時間は、あと十分ほどございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: After the bag is filled, the staff will close it. Do you have about ten more minutes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十分くらいなら大丈夫です。その後は予定があるので、この一袋まででよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十分だけ一袋に範囲を限り全清掃を約束しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: About ten minutes is fine. I have plans afterward, so may I limit my help to this one bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit your help in Japanese to ten minutes and one bag, without promising to do all the cleaning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その一袋で結構です。今、集めた落葉を入れ終わりました。手を離していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That one bag is enough. We have just finished putting in the gathered leaves. You can let go now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: もう離してよいのですね。これで一袋分のお手伝いができました。では、散歩に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指示で手を離し指定一袋で終えて散歩に戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can let go now, right? I have helped with one bag. I will return to my walk now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Let go as instructed, finish after the specified one bag, and say in Japanese that you will return to your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お手伝いありがとうございます。それでは、散歩の続きをお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your help. Please enjoy the rest of your walk. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かばんの車輪のことで、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with your bag's wheel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅へ来る途中で一つ取れました。引くと底が床に当たるので、このまま引きずって歩くのを止めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車輪一つ脱落で底が当たり引くのを止めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: One came off on the way to the station. When I pull the bag, its bottom hits the floor, so I stopped dragging it along.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that one wheel came off, the bottom touches the floor, and you stopped pulling it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず通路を空けて、こちらの端へ置いてください。取れた車輪もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, clear the walkway and put it at this edge. Do you also have the wheel that came off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 取れた車輪は拾って、この袋に入れました。かばんと一緒に持って帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾った車輪を部品として袋へ保存したと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I picked it up and put it in this bag. I want to take it home with the suitcase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese that you picked up the wheel and kept it in a bag as a part.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは修理できません。持ち運ぶお手伝いを、ご自身で頼める方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot repair it here. Is there someone you can ask yourself to help carry it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族へ迎えを頼めます。家族が来るまで、この端でかばんと一緒に待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 修理対応でなく家族迎えまでの本人待機場所を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can ask my family to pick me up. May I wait at this edge with my suitcase until they come?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a place where you can wait for family pickup, rather than for repair assistance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路をふさがなければ、こちらでお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can wait here as long as you do not block the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。家族に、かばんの状態が分かる写真と入口の場所を送っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待機場所を確認し破損写真と合流入口を家族へ送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait here. I will send my family a photo showing the suitcase's condition and the entrance location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the waiting place and say in Japanese that you will send your family a damage photo and the entrance where you will meet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お迎えの方と、会う場所も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also confirm where to meet the person picking you up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の外で会うと伝えます。家族が来たら一緒に持ち上げて運び、取れた車輪の袋も忘れず持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外入口で合流後家族と運搬し部品袋も持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them we will meet outside the entrance. When my family arrives, we will lift and carry it together, and I will remember to take home the bag with the detached wheel too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that after meeting outside the entrance, you will carry it with your family and take the bag of parts home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お迎えが来るまでお気をつけてお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care while waiting for your family to arrive. Goodbye.
